description: React functional component for creating and managing API keys, including form handling, user interactions, API calls, and UI layout. Implements key ownership, details, optional settings, and multiple nested accordions for advanced configurations. Also includes modal dialogs for creating a new key and user.

methods.name: fetchTeamModels
methods.description: Fetches models available to the team or user, returns list of model IDs.

methods.name: fetchUserModels
methods.description: Fetches models available to the user and updates state.

methods.name: getPredefinedTags
methods.description: Extracts unique tags from the provided data array.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Handles form submission to create a new API key, including validation, data processing, and API calls.

methods.name: handleCopy
methods.description: Handles copying the generated key to clipboard with user notification.

methods.name: fetchMcpAccessGroups
methods.description: Fetches MCP access groups for the current user.

methods.name: fetchUsers
methods.description: Performs user search based on email input with debounce.

methods.name: handleUserCreated
methods.description: Callback invoked upon creation of a new user to update form state.
